source_of_truth: Operator-approved harness-friction spec from 2026-05-08, preserved audit-trail memories on evidence-shape overgating and phase-level recursion, and existing lifecycle gate / completion-dispatch plan close-outs.

user_journeys.name: operator-sees-contradictory-gate-state-fail-loud
user_journeys.description: When persisted gate-state conflicts with the plan's declared gates, the operator gets a clear reconciliation error and INBOX evidence instead of silent normalization or a confusing later pause.
acceptance_signals: Contradictory state raises a typed reconciliation error
The offending artifact path and remediation are named
Gate-state bytes are unchanged on failure

user_journeys.name: operator-direct-dispatch-clears-pre-impl-once
user_journeys.description: For an eligible dev/test plan, the operator's direct dispatch command counts as the pre_impl approval while preserving explicit audit-trail evidence.
acceptance_signals: Eligible direct dispatch proceeds without a second approve/resume command
Gate-state event and INBOX event record the auto-clear
Protected and multi-gate cases still require explicit operator action

user_journeys.name: operator-can-distinguish-environmental-auditor-friction
user_journeys.description: When a volley stalls because the auditor cannot reproduce due to sandbox, CLI auth, or equivalent-evidence disagreement, the terminal evidence distinguishes that from a genuine implementation defect.
acceptance_signals: Environmental findings are classified separately from implementation defects
Evidence-shape disagreement requires equivalent saved/operator evidence
Mixed or unknown cases remain blocking
Terminal reporting recommends the next operator action without auto-signoff

non_goals: No phase-mode dispatch or auto-commit implementation
No conftest JARVIS_HOME or DONTPANIC_HOME isolation fix
No live nested orchestration during this plan's own implementation
No automatic signoff based on environmental or evidence-shape classification
completion_test: An eligible direct-dispatch plan can move through pre_impl with auditable auto-clear evidence, contradictory gate-state fails loud without mutation, and stopped/no-progress terminal reporting distinguishes environmental harness friction from real implementation defects while preserving blocking behavior for unknown or genuine defects.
